g.text: Figure 3c | Archived multivariate S-map across 50 trials

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: The exact archived coefficient cube is shown with a higher-contrast parula scale.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: Each direction is normalized to its own P2–median–P98 range so trial/time structure remains visible; absolute ranges are printed at right.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: Historical/full-data model: z-scored M1/M2/S1 regional activation and one-step 50-ms multivariate S-map; same-trial library points excluded; θ=4 selected by leave-one-trial-out forecast skill.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: Direction-wise normalization changes color only, not coefficients, so colors cannot compare absolute magnitude across directions.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: Slopes are predictive and non-causal; common task/movement structure was not removed.
